heading: Employer Gifts Up to ₹15,000 Now Tax-Free: What Salaried Taxpayers Need to Know
tldr: The annual tax-free limit for employer-provided gifts, vouchers, or tokens has been increased.
The new limit for such gifts is now ₹15,000, up from the previous ₹5,000.
This benefit is an aggregate annual limit, meaning it applies to the total value of gifts received in a financial year.
The change is effective as per the recently updated Income Tax Rules, 2026.
Salaried individuals should understand this rule to accurately assess their taxable income and perquisites.
caption:
Good news for your wallet! 🎉 If your company gives you gifts like vouchers or tokens, you might be paying less tax now. The government has raised the tax-free limit for these gifts from ₹5,000 to ₹15,000 a year. This means more of those awesome gifts stay tax-free in your pocket. Want to know exactly how it helps you? Read the full article to understand this simple change!
